stem: This is a cross-sectional diagram of a major operation ordered by President Harry S. Truman in 1948. The flight pattern illustrated in the diagram was designed to allow an airplane to land every three minutes. Why was this operation undertaken?

options.label: A
options.text: To enable a rapid withdrawal of troops from a war-torn city

options.label: C
options.text: To provide supplies to a blockaded city

options.label: D
options.text: To rescue thousands of stranded political refugees

visual_elements: Cross-sectional diagram showing airplanes spaced 500 feet apart vertically, 3 minutes apart horizontally, with 15 minutes total duration and 5000 feet distance between Rhein-Main and Berlin.
notes: Based on historical context, the operation is the Berlin Airlift to provide supplies to a blockaded city.
